title: Context compaction: Automatic summarization of old messages
description:
Implement automatic context compaction via summarization.

## How It Works
1. When context reaches threshold (e.g., 70%)
2. Summarize oldest N messages into single summary message
3. Replace original messages with summary
4. Continue conversation with compressed context

## Implementation
- Use LLM to generate summary
- Preserve key facts and decisions
- Mark summarized sections
- Allow viewing original in session file

## Commands
```
/compact         Force compaction now
/compact --undo  Restore from session file
```

## Acceptance
- Seamless compaction during conversation
- Summary captures essential context
- Original recoverable from session

description:
## Overview
Implement comprehensive end-to-end tests validating the context management system including:

## Test Scenarios

### Context Preservation
- [ ] Verify conversation history persists across multiple exchanges
- [ ] Test session save/load preserves all message content
- [ ] Validate function call/response pairs are maintained correctly
- [ ] Test model warnings when resuming sessions with different models

### Token Counting & Context Window
- [ ] Verify token counting accuracy against known text samples
- [ ] Test context window warning triggers at correct threshold (80%)
- [ ] Validate /tokens command output matches expected statistics
- [ ] Test remaining capacity calculations

### Session Continuation
- [ ] Test --continue <name> flag loads correct session
- [ ] Test --continue-last flag loads most recent session
- [ ] Test /continue command in REPL
- [ ] Validate conversation can resume after reload

### Session Export
- [ ] Test JSON export produces valid, re-importable JSON
- [ ] Test Markdown export includes all conversation elements
- [ ] Verify function calls/responses render correctly in export

### Memory/Compaction (future)
- [ ] Test auto-summarization when context approaches limit
- [ ] Verify sliding window preserves recent messages
- [ ] Test compaction maintains conversation coherence

## Acceptance Criteria
- All e2e tests pass in CI
- Tests cover happy path and error scenarios
- Tests are deterministic and reproducible

title: Context window: Sliding window with configurable limits
description:
Implement sliding context window management.

## Features
- Configurable max tokens (default: provider limit)
- Keep system prompt always
- Keep recent N messages always
- Truncate oldest messages first

## Configuration
```
--max-context-tokens 8000
--keep-recent-messages 10
```

## Strategies
1. Hard truncation (drop oldest)
2. Soft truncation (summarize oldest)
3. Smart truncation (keep important messages)

## Acceptance
- Never exceed token limit
- Recent context preserved
- Smooth conversation flow
